images.title: Five image habits for faster pages
images.alt: Checklist of image habits: resize before upload, use WebP or AVIF, set width and height, lazy-load lower images, never lazy-load the main one.
images.caption: The LCP element is often the featured image at the top of the post.

items: Resize before you upload, to roughly the largest display size
Use a modern format such as WebP or AVIF
Give every image a width and height
Lazy-load images further down the page
Never lazy-load the main image at the top

images.note: Adding fetchpriority="high" to the main image tells the browser to fetch it early

images.title: Save space for what arrives late
images.alt: Four ways to prevent layout shift: set image dimensions, reserve ad slots, size embed containers, and make banners overlay the page.
images.caption: Layout shift almost always comes from something arriving into a space nobody saved for it.

items.title: Images
items.text: Set a width and height on every image.

items.title: Ads
items.text: Reserve a slot with a fixed minimum height so text isn't pushed down.

items.title: Embeds
items.text: Put videos, social posts and iframes in a container with a set size.

items.title: Banners
items.text: Have cookie notices and newsletter bars overlay the page.
